findings.evidence: The sun is drawn as a bright disc/glare in front of the camera, but the spec places it behind the viewer's left shoulder, so it should not appear in frame.
Shadows fall toward the viewer and to the right under a strong frontal glare, instead of the short forward-and-right shadows the spec requires for a sun behind the left shoulder.
